name: COBOL TUI member kiosk API client

mentions.name: COBOL TUI member kiosk API client
mentions.description: This terminal UI app displays and interacts with the API of a CS student association's member kiosk system. It is written in GnuCOBOL and uses curl for its API requests.
mentions.source_excerpt: A TUI written in gnuCOBOL to show and interact with the API of my cs student associations cursed member kiosk system. (Using curl, as I still want to live).
